text:
alex_infra: FYI vendor just updated ETA for 60 H100s — slipped 8 business days, still pending customs clearance. any quick mitigation ideas?
marisa_ops: Ugh, that's right in our Q3 cold-start window. Do we have loaner capacity in EU to cover the most critical pools?
sophia_sre: We have ~12 spare H100s in eu-west but they're pegged to infra-testing. Can reclaim 6 if we postpone nightly perf runs for 48h.
dan_prod: Which routes are we hitting? region constraints matter — customer-facing latency could regress if we drop too many nodes in prod.
marisa_ops: Prioritize reclaim for dedupe/embedding fleet only, not latency-critical gen. That should limit impact.
tomas_vendor: Apologies — carrier flagged incorrect HS code, vendor ops fixed paperwork this morning. We can offer expedited air for the 12 flagged units at +18% per-unit vs original quote. Also can ship a partial RMA replacement (12 units) immediately as loaners while rest clear customs.
alex_infra: @tomas_vendor what's the earliest partial shipment AWB we can provide? need tracking to plan rack scheduling.
tomas_vendor: Can ship AWB tomorrow EOD, ETA to eu-west in 48h via air. I’ll post AWB once scheduled. RMA ref: RMA-2024-9812.
supply_bot: RMA created RMA-2024-9812 for PO#RDW-4820 by tomas_vendor. Docs: https://vendor-portal.example.com/RMA-2024-9812 :white_check_mark:
dan_prod: Cost math — +18% air for 12 units vs risking 8 business day delay. If we choose air, what's net impact on Q3 margins?
marisa_ops: Ballpark: extra ~$216k one-time; saves ~4 days of revenue slowdown for a subset of customers. ROI depends on SLA penalties — if we hit SLOs we avoid any credits.
sophia_sre: Also consider ops lift: expedited air needs overnight customs clearance + broker fee. Recommend split cost: vendor absorbs brokerage, we cover air uplift at 50/50.
tomas_vendor: Vendor can absorb brokerage up to $3k but cannot cover air uplift. 50/50 split is acceptable if Redwood commits to confirmed allocation schedule for remaining units.
alex_infra: Sounds fair. Decision: approve partial air for 12 units with 50/50 uplift, vendor covers brokerage. Proceed if you confirm AWB tomorrow.
marisa_ops: Confirmed from PM side — we'll accept 50/50 and reclaim 6 spares from testing. Can ops schedule rack space and power on arrival?
dan_prod: I'll update runbooks: mark reclaimed 6 as preemptible in autoscaler, ensure critical routes exclude them.
sophia_sre: I'll block nightly tests for 48h and prep image refresh.
tomas_vendor: AWB scheduled, tracking: AWB123456789. ETA eu-west 48h. Initiated export insurance claim Q-453 for damaged crate (one unit) — vendor will replace under warranty, expect RMA update in 24h.
supply_bot: Insurance claim Q-453 logged. Status: pending vendor inspection.
alex_infra: Noted one DOA possibility. If crate arrives DOA, what's fallback? can we hot-swap with a refurbished unit from vendor pool immediately?
tomas_vendor: We have 2 refurbished H100s staged at FRA that can go same-day RMA swap if DOA confirmed on arrival photos. Need depot acceptance photo + serial to trigger.
marisa_ops: Ops checklist: 1) accept AWB, 2) photo inspection, 3) serial verification, 4) trigger refurb swap if DOA. I'll create ticket ops/PROV-728.
dan_prod: Also update capacity forecast sheet and inform customers on rolling deploy changes. I'll DM account leads.
sophia_sre: Quick note: adjust KV cache warmers for reclaimed nodes so cold-start impact is minimized.
alex_infra: OK — I'll merge this into the provisioning runbook, tagging RMA-2024-9812 and AWB123456789. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
